title: Zero-friction model chooser and inline request-composer screenshot set
creator: Aisha Moreno
description: Purpose: produce a compact, production-ready screenshot bundle for the Hosted API getting-started docs that highlights the model selection microflow, an inline request composer, and three idiomatic code snippet states (curl, Python SDK, and Node SDK). Scope: 1) a new model-chooser microflow screenshot showing model categories, recommended default, and cost/latency badge; 2) inline request-composer screenshots capturing prompt templating, structured output toggle, and a streaming response state; 3) code snippet hero images with highlighted lines for token budgeting and function/tool-calling examples; 4) a small set of 1x1, 4x3, and hero-sized exports for docs, in-product help, and marketing landing banners. Key goals: make the experience feel fast and low-friction for first-time devs, surface cost/latency tradeoffs, and show how to switch models without leaving the composer. Out of scope: localization variants and alternate color themes (will follow in a follow-up ticket).
acceptance_criteria: 1) All screenshots exported at 2x and original vector sources committed to Drive. 2) Model-chooser microflow clearly shows default model card, cost/latency badge, and 'pins to project' affordance. 3) Request composer demonstrates placeholder variables, structured-output toggle, and streaming spinner state. 4) Three code snippet images show working examples that match docs copy and have highlighted token-budget lines. 5) Docs team approves final assets in a review meeting and attaches final filenames to the PR.
notes_and_tradeoffs: - We intentionally keep the model card compact to avoid overwhelming new users; this sacrifices showing every metric (e.g., throughput percentile) in favor of cost and latency badges. - Streaming state is represented as a 'typing' shimmer in screenshots rather than a full GIF to keep assets simple and repo-friendly. - We do not attempt to surface Dedicated vs Hosted routing in these assets to avoid product surface confusion; that will be emphasized in Dedicated landing pages.
engineering_requirements: ENG: implement a temporary demo flag to show cost/latency badges in the staging UI for clean screenshots (ENG-20112). Provide a stable URL for the composer so screenshots are reproducible. Coordinate with ENG to freeze the staging UI on 2025-02-10 for asset capture.
documentation_requirements: Docs: update getting-started pages to reference the new hero images and swap inline code blocks to match the snippet images (PM-4199). Ensure copy for token budgeting aligns with highlighted lines in images.
